pack.name: EmpireDivers Forge
pack.notes: EmpireDivers r54 (v2.2.1): Fixed out-of-bounds LOD0 cull_node (157 -> 83) and film-scale frustum bounds across all 4 AT-ST walkers (EXO-45/49/51/55), fixed Parade Stormtrooper (`bc20d0b4efff128c`) and custom Imperial helmet/armor double-shifted Z & bounding-sphere culling across all 5 performance tiers with 0 B `.gpu_resources`/`.stream` churn and 100% preserved TIE/LEGO/Yoda runtime pins.
pack.statusNotes: Verified across all 5 tiers (full, lighter, reduced1024, reduced512, potato256) with 0 duplicate keys, 0 missing dependencies, 0 codec mismatches, and 100% unit_safe (<=64 bones, unique mkeys).

textureProfiles.name: Full (Ultra)
